forensic.headerSubtitle: Complete integrity details for this submission
forensic.graphClickEdge: Click an edge for split-screen comparison
forensic.cleanMsg: This student shows no structural similarity connections or direct inspiration from other peers in the database. All computed scores are below the critical 50% threshold.
forensic.phrasesMsg: {n} phrases with common ideational structure detected beyond the critical Jaccard word threshold
forensic.legendHover: Hover over a fragment to highlight the match in the opposite panel.
forensic.devOkMsg: Consistent Style. The text matches the student's historic linguistic fingerprint perfectly.
forensic.devSuspectMsg: Stylometric Anomaly. There is a visible deviation; possibly heavily edited or paraphrased text.
forensic.devCriticalMsg: Author Rupture. The deviation is extreme; statistically impossible for the student to radically change style. Likely AI or another author.
forensic.aiClassCriticalDesc: Text almost certainly generated by AI. The phrase structure is geometric, perfectly matching predictive patterns.
forensic.aiClassGreyDesc: Hybrid or assisted text. Stylistically uniformized structure, indicating AI use for rephrasing.
forensic.aiClassSafeDesc: Human Text. Natural, asymmetric and dynamic rhythm.
forensic.webScanningSubtitle: Gemini Flash + cosine similarity on indexed sources
forensic.webNoMatches: No matches detected in the public online index.
forensic.webSourcesTitle: Geometric distance in the online index:
forensic.webNoteText: Manual verification of indicated links is recommended. The AI Grounding system identifies bibliographic correlations and related sources, but final evaluation requires human validation as data may vary.
forensic.webVerdictAuthentic: ✅ AUTHENTIC TEXT: Original text with respect to the public online index.
forensic.webVerdictDetected: ❌ DETECTED: Text sourced from the internet (Cosine Similarity: {pct}%).
forensic.webVerdictSuspect: ❓ SUSPECT: Partially similar structure or intelligent paraphrasing ({pct}%).
forensic.webScanIncomplete: Incomplete scan: Google Grounding returned no URLs. Check GEMINI_API_KEY in .env.local and click Re-scan.

radarTab.title: Stylometric Radar — {name}
radarTab.verdictOkMsg: Natural human variation. The student used a slightly different topic or the text has a different length, but the base structural pattern remains unchanged.
radarTab.verdictSuspectMsg: Grey zone. Visible change in vocabulary or phrase structure. May indicate external help, partial copying, or translation from another language.
radarTab.verdictAlertMsg: Major structural deviation. It is nearly impossible for the same student to simultaneously change verb density, adjectives, punctuation and sentence length by over 38%. Text likely AI-generated or fully copied.
radarTab.testBaselineNote: This test updated the student's reference fingerprint. The deviation shown is computed against the previous reference.
